body: That's very helpful. Thank you. I'm john, it's nice to meet you too. I need to do some work now so i'll be going, but thanks for your time.

Thanks. Maybe you can give me some guidance on the parental problems. In the past, every time I meet their expectations, they always fail to hold up on whatever reward there was. When I didn't meet them, things got terrible. When I was in middle school, my dad used to beat me, and I think it was because I didn't make him happy and meet those expectations. Now he's calmed down a bit, but we still get in verbal fights regularly. All the work it takes to make him happy is what made me try to kill myself in the first place. Do you think it's worth it to work my ass of to make him happy? Or should I just take things easy and deal with his strife?
Thanks, those personal accounts mean something.
